## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete trigger, the previous behavior and the resulting behavior. Link a related issue when available.

## Scope and compatibility

Explain effects on parsers, resource limits, storage/schema, exports, networking/offline behavior or dependencies. State material limitations; omit sections that do not apply.

## Verification performed

List exact commands and meaningful manual/browser checks actually run, including the environment. Explain any unrun checks rather than marking them complete.

- [ ] Relevant tests/type/build checks pass
- [ ] Valid/malformed/boundary fixtures cover changed parser behavior where applicable
- [ ] Worker, storage, layout or offline browser checks cover the changed execution path where applicable
- [ ] Documentation/help/translations/changelog reflect the behavior
- [ ] New third-party material has recorded provenance and actual license terms
- [ ] No generated distributions, credentials, private evidence or sensitive case data are included

## UI evidence

For visible changes, attach safe before/after screenshots or describe the keyboard/accessibility review. Do not attach unreviewed real evidence.
